meta.name: ortus-cp-egress
meta.description: The egress flow of the control plane (control-plane/docs/operator-guide.md), behind Pomerium's egress route: only the hosts of the credentials nono holds, from the podman secrets cp.sh creates, or on p1 from run-nono.sh (dev/stage0/README.md). Every other host a job reaches is in the offer's policy (the workflow's environment.remote.egress and the repository's .sortie/egress.yaml), which the worker allows directly
